redundant_image_indicators.description: Screen readers already announce images; these terms are redundant.

unnecessary_action_verbs.description: Action verbs add length without improving meaning in alt text.

visual_only_references.description: References assume visual perception and reduce accessibility.

technical_file_terms.description: File or technical terms do not convey the image’s purpose.

decorative_filler_words.description: Decorative or filler words add subjectivity without informational value.

subjective_language.description: Subjective language should be avoided unless the image purpose is evaluative.

REMOVE_PHRASE.description: Remove matched phrase(s) without restructuring the sentence.

REMOVE_WORD.description: Remove individual filler or subjective words.

REWRITE_SENTENCE.description: Rewrite the sentence to remove unnecessary verbs and start with meaningful content.

REMOVE_AND_REWRITE.description: Remove visual-only references and restate content without positional or visual cues.

REPLACE_WITH_MEANING.description: Replace technical terms with a description of image purpose.

REWRITE_OBJECTIVELY.description: Convert subjective language into neutral, observable descriptions.
